item.title: [03 Nov] Can We Make AIs Sentient – and Should We? Solms vs Humphrey Live Debate
item.description:
When: Tuesday 03 November 2026, 20:15
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

To celebrate the publication of “*Perspectives on Machine Consciousness”*, we are hosting a live online debate between two of the leading thinkers in the science of consciousness. Mark Solms is a neuroscientist and psychoanalyst at the University of Cape Town. His book *The Hidden Spring* argues that consciousness is rooted in feeling, generated deep in the brainstem rather than the cortex. He is now working to build artificial agents that genuinely feel.
